_consumed_by: scripts/mras_map_answers.py — reads this canonical truth + per-survey QID definitions (working/mras-discovery/<opp>-qid-definitions.json) and emits the per-survey answer map.

socioeconomic_indicators._rule: Per user confirmation 2026-05-27, SpatialGIS holds SBA-certified Small Disadvantaged Business status — select 'd' on GSA MRAS. SAM still shows code 27 (self-cert) as of 2026-05-27; recommend updating SAM businessTypeCode to reflect formal SBA cert so SAM-driven systems pick it up. Do NOT add HUBZone/8(a)/SDVOSB/WOSB or other formal certs — none verified to apply.

gsa_contracts_held._rule: SpatialGIS holds exactly one GSA contract solution applicable to MRAS: the Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) 47QTCA24D00DS. Do NOT select POLARIS, POLARIS WOSB/SDVOSB/HUBZONE, VETS 2, 8A STARS 3, OASIS+, or any GWAC that SpatialGIS does not currently hold.

gsa_sin_eligibility._rule: SpatialGIS MAS SINs: 541370GIS (Geospatial), 518210C (Cloud), 54151S (IT Professional Services), 541515 (Computer Services), 541611 (Management Consulting). When the survey offers SIN-level options, select only those that SpatialGIS holds AND that match the requirement. NEVER select POLARIS/VETS/STARS sub-pools.

commercial_item_far_part_12._note: SpatialGIS services are offered commercially under the GSA MAS; FAR Part 12 Subpart 12.1 applies.

naics_self_qualified._rule: SpatialGIS is small business under all of these SAM-registered NAICS. Pick whichever the survey offers that matches the agency's intended NAICS for the requirement (usually stated in the DRD).

subcontracting_intent_default._note: Default to None unless the per-opportunity profile overrides. SpatialGIS prime-only delivery on MAS-class requirements is the norm; teaming is opportunity-specific.

lead_time_default._note: Standard MAS task-order lead time. Override per opportunity if the DRD indicates longer ramp.

would_submit_quote_default._note: If we're answering an MRAS at all, we're indicating interest in quoting. If the per-opportunity assessment is No, drop the opportunity from the auto-submittable list instead.

_per_opportunity_overrides_schema: Each opportunity profile lives at working/mras-answers/<opportunity-id>.json and contains: { survey_url, qid_definitions_path, capability_statement_path, capability_questions_answers: { QID14_1: 'Yes'|'No'|'See capability statement', ... }, naics_selection: ['541519'], sin_selection: ['54151S','518210C'], subcontracting_override?, lead_time_override?, capability_statement_explainer? } The mapper combines canonical_truth + per-opportunity overrides + the survey's QID definitions to produce the final per-survey answer map.
